summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories like Hugging Face—which surpassed 3 million public models in August 2026—and a growing tier of developer-facing inference platforms (Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, SiliconFlow, and others) that make open-weight models easy to run locally or via API. Download distribution is highly concentrated: roughly half of all Hugging Face models have fewer than 200 downloads, while the top 200 models account for nearly 50% of all downloads. These hubs and APIs are distinct from enterprise aggregators (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and MLOps platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI), focusing instead on open access, rapid prototyping, and cost-efficient serverless inference.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central hub for hosting, discovering, and sharing open-source models, datasets, and Spaces demos, plus serverless and dedicated inference endpoints.
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public repos and basic Inference API; PRO at ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints and dedicated GPU compute billed by usage/hour; Enterprise Hub custom pricing
features: Largest open model and dataset repository
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Spaces for hosting demos and apps
Model cards, download stats, and versioning via Git LFS
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and open-source developers who need the broadest selection of models, datasets, and collaboration tools.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first tool for running open LLMs and multimodal models on your own machine with a simple CLI and local API.
platforms.model_count: ~200+ curated models in its library (plus community GGUF imports from Hugging Face)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; no usage fees since inference runs on local hardware
features: One-command model pulls and runs (e.g., 'ollama run llama3')
Local REST API compatible with OpenAI format
Quantized GGUF model support for consumer hardware
platforms.best_for: Developers and hobbyists who want to run open models locally for privacy, offline use, or prototyping without cloud costs.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and deploying open-source models (image, video, audio, and LLMs) via a simple API without managing infrastructure.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing); no subscription required
features: One-line API calls to run any published model
Cog packaging framework for deploying custom models
Strong catalog of image/video/audio generation models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want to call diverse open models (especially generative media) via API with minimal setup and usage-based billing.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-source LLMs, offering fast serverless APIs and dedicated endpoints.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Mixtral, Qwen, DeepSeek, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (tiered by model size); dedicated GPU instances and fine-tuning billed separately
features: Broad catalog including chat, code, embedding, and image models
platforms.best_for: Startups and developers building production apps on open models who need scalable, fast, cost-effective token-based inference.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A speed-optimized inference platform for open and fine-tuned LLMs and multimodal models, targeting low-latency production workloads.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; on-demand and reserved GPU deployments; fine-tuning billed by usage
features: FireAttention engine for fast, low-latency inference
LoRA fine-tuning and custom model deployment
Function calling and structured JSON output
platforms.best_for: Teams prioritizing inference speed and latency for production LLM applications on open and fine-tuned models.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: An inference cloud offering fast, affordable API access to a wide range of open-source LLMs, image, and audio models, popular in Asian markets.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, FLUX, and others)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with competitive low pricing; free credits for some models; dedicated deployment options
features: Strong support for Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen)
platforms.best_for: Developers seeking low-cost inference and strong support for leading Chinese open-weight models.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform powered by custom LPU hardware for running open LLMs at very high token speeds.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Mixtral, Qwen, Gemma)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with free developer tier; competitive per-million-token rates
features: Very low latency for real-time applications
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-sensitive, real-time applications needing the fastest possible inference speeds.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single interface.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated across dozens of providers
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing with provider markups; credit-based wallet; many free-tier models
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Price and latency comparison across providers
Access to both open and closed models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want provider flexibility, redundancy, and a single API to access many open and proprietary models.
